summary: Implementation plan for the AI-powered Banner Ad Generator Studio, supporting all standard IAB and social ad sizes, high-quality image generation with gemini-3-pro-image-preview and gemini-nano-banana-2.1, configurable resolution (1K, 2K, 4K), aspect ratio controls (1:1, 2:3, 3:2, 3:4, 4:3, 9:16, 16:9, 21:9), and an in-app visual editor for live typography and CTA customization.
